decisive_items: irregular red lacunae with irregular vessels and absence of septa
ectatic thin-walled vessels with multiple intravascular branching papillary structures
swollen endothelial cells with numerous intracytoplasmic eosinophilic hyaline globules
response.rationale: The dermoscopic and histopathological findings are more specifically consistent with Hobnail Hemangioma, a rare vascular tumor, due to the presence of characteristic irregular red lacunae and swollen endothelial cells with hyaline globules.

rejected.why: While Dabska tumor shares some features, the specific combination of dermoscopic and histopathological findings points more towards Hobnail Hemangioma.
